summary: Re-verified shopped records fixes: rounding via Decimal money_round() and sort by shopped_at. Ran pytest backend/tests/test_shopped_records.py — 7/7 PASSED including the previously failing TestHappyPath::test_execute_single_item_with_tax (now correctly returns total_amount=27.13, tax_amount=2.13, total_with_tax=27.13). No frontend or other regression suites executed per request.
critical_code_review_comments: money_round() correctly uses Decimal(str(v)).quantize(Decimal('0.01'), ROUND_HALF_UP) — proper banker's-safe HALF_UP rounding for currency.
get_shopped_batch now sorts by shopped_at which matches the semantic of when items were shopped rather than created_at.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seed/admin fixtures from test file.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_shopped_records.py reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env (matches frontend/.env key). When running pytest manually, export EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=<preview-url> first. Public URL: https://store-manager-pro-9.preview.emergentagent.com. All 7 shopped-record tests green in 5.19s.
rca_of_issue: Previous iteration's failure (expected 27.13, got 27.12) was due to standard float round() banker's rounding edge case on 27.125. Replacing with Decimal-based HALF_UP rounding fixes the cent drift across purchase_price, line_total, tax_amount, total_with_tax, and total_amount. Verified by re-running the exact failing case.
